description: automatic.sral.fi is the Finnish Amateur Radio League's register of automatic amateur radio stations in Finland: voice repeaters, beacons, APRS digipeaters, amateur television repeaters and data network nodes. The site read on 2026-09-28 (last updated that day) lists 260 stations in a table giving status, transmit frequency, channel, callsign, location, polarisation, modes, access tone, transmitter power in watts and height above sea level in metres, for example the Turku, Espoo, Tampere and Lapua repeaters, and offers a map, statistics, a changelog, channel number tables, a FinDMR section and an export function. Coverage is national. Access is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the register is maintained by volunteers, coordinates are approximate on the map, and station status (active or silent) changes. It supports modelling of backup emergency communication networks when public mobile and power networks fail, such as repeater coverage during storms. Related records: data-ira-iceland-repeaters-digipeaters-beacons and data-hrvhf-croatia-repeater-list are comparable national registers.
